hero.title: File:Nike Site SF-88L (2748317393).jpg
hero.description: The Nike system was rapidly made obsolete, but sites such as this one in Marin are still around.  There's another on Angel Island though I didn't get a good photo of it.  There are plenty to be found, though.

gallery.credit: SF-88 Nike Hercules Missile Site [00]: Launcher
gallery.source: SF-88 Nike Hercules Missile Site (00)- Launcher (7399540404)
gallery.description:
The Nike-Hercules missile on the launchpad. Florian Kainz expertly conceived of and coordinated multiple off-camera light flashes during this single long-exposure shot.
This image is a United States Government Work; it is in the public domain.

Photographer: Bhautik Joshi, 2012

gallery.title: File:Hill 88 Abandoned Radar Station (3231036200).jpg
gallery.artist: David Berry from Rohnert Park CA, USA
gallery.description: On the top of Hill 88 on Wolf Ridge are the remains of a  radar station which was part of the secret  Cold-War era SF-88 Nike Missile launch site nearby at Fort Barry. Structure on left is a radar platform which has mostly collapsed in the past couple of years.
